api.pose: pose(phase: String, progress: float, direction: Vector3, hit_flash: bool = false) -> void
api.progress: Normalized parent phase clock, clamped to [0,1]; nonfinite progress becomes zero
api.direction: World planar direction. Invalid or zero inputs retain the last valid direction. Mirror yaw follows every supplied valid direction; parent supplies immutable direction during lock/active
api.pre_ready_calls: Requested live pose or explicit saved pose/body yaw is retained and applied after _ready; invalid explicit restore leaves the pending tuple untouched. Normal first pose initializes chassis heading from its supplied direction even when directly entering lock/active/recovery; explicit restoration applies the saved latch instead.
api.snapshot: Actor schema2 saves get_body_yaw() separately from phase/progress/world direction; its validator calls restore_pose_error before mutation and restore_pose applies the exact saved latch. Next held warning/lock/active/recovery/defeated samples preserve that plant. Idle/approach and a later new warning entry retain existing live-facing behavior. Parent supplies any separate hit-flash clock; actor restore draws no flash.
api.get_body_yaw: get_body_yaw() -> float; returns the local planted cosmetic chassis yaw, distinct from the current world mirror direction
api.restore_pose_error: restore_pose_error(phase: String, progress: float, direction: Vector3, body_yaw: float) -> String; pure preflight for supported phase, finite normalized progress/direction and finite canonical yaw in [-PI, PI] with a 0.000001-radian JSON boundary tolerance
api.restore_pose: restore_pose(phase: String, progress: float, direction: Vector3, body_yaw: float, hit_flash: bool = false) -> bool; validates then silently restores the saved tuple and warning-entry plant, without deriving a new chassis yaw from the mirror direction
api.readability: apply_readability(camera: Camera3D, hero_bounds: Array[Vector3]) -> bool;3–16 finite current camera-facing world silhouette points, same-world orthographic camera; no mutation on invalid input. clear_readability() -> void and defensive readability_state() -> Dictionary; weak camera/current derived points reapply after pose/restore. No timer, opacity save field or new processing.
